events.title: 3i Group Capital Markets Day: Action Sales Jump 16% to €16B, Maps Europe Growth and U.S. Launch Plan
events.body: 3i Group (LON:III) executives and Action’s management team used a capital markets seminar to outline Action’s 2025 results, discuss the discount retailer’s operating model, and detail expansion plans across Europe and into the United States

events.title: 3i Group PLC (TGOPF) (Q2 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Returns Amidst Challenging Markets
events.body: 3i Group PLC (TGOPF) reports a 13% total return and significant NAV growth, while navigating macroeconomic challenges in France.
